content: Letter 16, Ibn Turka's reply to Shāhrukh's summons to attend court during Shāhrukh's first campaign in western Iran of mid-817/1414: sent from Isfahan to Yazd to be conveyed to Shāhrukh by Sayyid Niʿmat Allāh Valī. The summons coincided with Shāhrukh's capture of Iskandar, Ibn Turka's erstwhile patron, and installation of Ibrāhīm Sulṭān b. Shāhrukh as governor of Fars; Ibn Turka conveys admiration and well-wishing to the newly ascendant ruler and assures him he will attend court (TMN/M f. 148a, TMN/MS pp. 11-12, TMN/D pp. 170-73; edition in MK's P.2.1).
